response.sql: WITH sentiment_transactions AS (SELECT sf.transref, tr.tradekind, sf.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg), combination_averages AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS combo_avg_optvolrt FROM sentiment_transactions GROUP BY transref, tradekind), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(combo_avg_optvolrt) AS baseline_value FROM combination_averages), with_deviations AS (SELECT ca.transref, ca.tradekind, ca.combo_avg_optvolrt, ca.combo_avg_optvolrt - b.baseline_value AS deviation FROM combination_averages ca CROSS JOIN baseline b), type_avg_deviations AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS type_avg_deviation FROM with_deviations WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tradekind), kept_combinations AS (SELECT wd.transref, wd.tradekind, wd.combo_avg_optvolrt, wd.deviation, wd.deviation - tad.type_avg_deviation AS excess FROM with_deviations wd INNER JOIN type_avg_deviations tad ON wd.tradekind = tad.tradekind WHERE wd.deviation > tad.type_avg_deviation) SELECT tradekind, AVG(combo_avg_optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept_combinations GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind;
